sources.title: Architecture graph for ic4u2u/dama-aibrain | hfviewer
sources.snippet: ic4u2u/dama-aibrain architecture at a glance ic4u2u/dama-aibrain is an image-text-to-text model (gemma4_text architecture). It uses 35 transformer layers, a hidden size of 1,536, and 8 query heads with 1 key/value heads (grouped-query attention). The feed-forward layers use an intermediate size of 6,144.
